bibliographic_record.title: Pseudoreplication and the Design of Ecological Field Experiments

verbatim_excerpt: Ecological Monographs, Volume 54, Issue 2, pp. 187-211. 'Scrutiny of 176 experimental studies published between 1960 and the present revealed that pseudoreplication occurred in 27% of them, or 48% of all such studies that applied inferential statistics.'
